_README.description: Model metadata for Anthropic's Claude API access. Used by providers/anthropic.py and the clink claude→API OAuth fallback.
_README.usage: Models listed here are exposed directly through the Anthropic provider. Aliases are case-insensitive.
_README.field_notes: Matches providers/shared/model_capabilities.py. Anthropic models support extended thinking via the SDK's 'thinking' parameter; the provider maps Panel's effort levels to those budgets.

models.description: Claude Opus 4.8 — Anthropic's flagship reasoning model. 1M-token context. Strongest for deep code review, architecture, and adversarial debate. Powers panel/multiaudit's claude panelist.
Claude Sonnet 5 — balanced flagship reaching near-Opus quality on coding and agentic work. 1M-token context, strong reasoning at lower cost and faster latency than Opus.
Claude Haiku 4.5 — small, fast, and cheap. Best for high-volume review or quick second opinions.
